original_sources.independent_butterfly_denominator: INBO Eurobutt checklist present on 18 real Macaronesian islands, 42 species including 1 historical extinct Madeira taxon
original_sources.source_status: Original literature manually read; source-typed transcription/identity checks executed in GitHub Actions. 2010 PDF byte digest was NOT obtained from original URL in CI.

extant_independent_coverage.historical_excluded_note: Pieris wollastoni has historic host reports but extinct taxa are not included in current extant-resource inference.
extant_independent_coverage.documented_rate_interpretation: Literature-source confirmation lower bound, NOT an unbiased biological true known-host rate and not presence of a plant on each individual island

E_grancanariensis.taxonomy: 2010 primary paper Euchloe belemia grancanariensis subspecies concept; independent Canary BIOTA accepts Euchloe grancanariensis as distinct endemic species
E_grancanariensis.hard_boundary: Oviposition is not demonstrated successful larval development; 5 pupae is not five adult recruits. Neither 9/15 nor 5/15 is a representative field population parameter.

H_tamadabae.field_larvae_record: 2016-12, Gran Canaria taxon tamadabae larvae on unidentified tussock grass
H_tamadabae.exclude_candidate: Hyparrhenia hirta was nearby but not recorded with larvae; never transfer as host

E_hesperidum_companion.study_context: Single field-collected larva fed plant materials in captivity. Do not count 3 offered plants as independent larvae.
E_hesperidum_companion.interpretation: Unreplicated illustrative host-use contrast versus field E. grancanariensis larvae on H. incana; cannot identify evolutionary host specialization mechanism

original_GEB_unchanged.new_endemic_alien_host_direct_example: Pieris cheiranthi larva on Tropaeolum majus in Tenerife and La Palma, previously separately verified
original_GEB_unchanged.ecology_filter: Plant species exists -> butterfly accepts and larvae feed -> larval survival/pupation -> successful reproduction/dispersal; each is a distinct evidence stage
original_GEB_unchanged.future_gate: Source-independent plant species resolved larval host interactions + island-specific plant status and presence + performance for each independently listed island butterfly. Host genera with introduced congeners do not suffice.
